description: This file contains the implementation of a Python class PreviewImage that generates and saves preview images from FITS files, primarily used for JWST observations. It includes methods for reading FITS data, processing images, creating matplotlib figures, and handling file outputs. The script is intended for command-line or programmatic usage to visualize astronomical image data.

classes.name: PreviewImage
classes.description: A class for generating, visualizing, and saving preview images from FITS files containing JWST observation data.

methods.name: __init__(self, filename, extension)
methods.description: Initializes the PreviewImage object, loads fitting data extension.

methods.name: difference_image(self, data)
methods.description: Creates difference images by subtracting the first group from the last group for each integration.

methods.name: find_limits(self, data, pixmap, clipperc)
methods.description: Calculates display limits for image scaling after sigma clipping based on pixel values.

methods.name: get_data(self, filename, ext)
methods.description: Reads data and data quality information for specified extension in a FITS file.

methods.name: make_figure(self, image, integration_number, min_value, max_value, scale, maxsize=8, thumbnail=False)
methods.description: Creates a matplotlib figure for the image, supporting linear and log scaling, and both full and thumbnail sizes.

methods.name: make_image(self, max_img_size=8)
methods.description: Main function that generates preview images and thumbnails for each integration in the data.

methods.name: save_image(self, fname, thumbnail=False)
methods.description: Saves the current matplotlib figure to a file and sets permissions.

ctags.name: make_figure
ctags.pattern: /^    def make_figure(self, image, integration_number, min_value, max_value,$/
ctags.signature: (self, image, integration_number, min_value, max_value, scale, maxsize=8, thumbnail=False)
